kgi_status.target: Complete the frozen review-portfolio batch through exact-revision review, gates, Close, Install, Dogfood, and Retrospect with no blocking residual.
kgi_status.observed: The MR-list and MR-mutation repair lanes reached exact candidate revisions and independent rereviews are active, but no current-wave product package is integrated and the batch remains open.

kgi_status.target: Zero critical escapes, zero accepted false-completion claims, and complete fresh evidence.
kgi_status.observed: Independent review logs contain confirmed candidate-owned storage and MR-list defects, and the MR-list focused gate retains one unclassified non-repeatable failure. Formal reports are pending and neither candidate has been accepted.

kgi_status.target: Zero lost source work, durable checkpoints for every mutated lane, and measured recovery from provider/host/resource incidents.
kgi_status.observed: Three host restarts occurred in the recovery period. Exact Git reconstruction and checkpoints preserved source work; the measured 91.8 GiB Cargo duplication was removed and current active mutated lanes are checkpointed.

kgi_status.target: No batch stop caused solely by Codex quota; Claude/Fugu implementation and review remain recoverable from portable Git/log evidence.
kgi_status.observed: Two Claude Opus 5 implementation lanes produced durable candidates and three Fugu 1.1 Ultra product reviews plus one Claude control-plane review are active without external Codex implementation. Codex remains the coordinator.

kgi_status.target: After five comparable packets, reduce next-cohort median trusted-integration lead time and total cost by at least 20% with non-inferior quality.
kgi_status.observed: The first comparable five-packet cohort is not complete, so no efficiency target is claimed as achieved.

lane_runs.outcome: The live review had stabilized at six or more candidate-owned blockers and was resolving a precedence contradiction; the formal committed report was still pending at capture.

The final product and test commits report zero nested/hidden work, linear 1x/3x/10x counters, three clean focused runs, prior-candidate reversal, and detection of all seven deliberate mutations; independent rereview is active.

Product, tests, and source docs were committed; twelve later focused reruns and fourteen targeted stress runs were clean, but the first unexplained failure remains unclassified and independent rereview has reproduced separate candidate-owned defects.
The outage hedge remained clean and produced no unique artifact after the Claude lane reached a clean committed candidate; its slot was reclaimed for independent review.
Socket-level probes had reproduced a stale-success fence/publication race and a symlinked authority-directory false success; the formal report was pending.
The schema, checker, KGI/KPI semantics, baseline arithmetic, anti-gaming controls, and evidence binding were under independent review.
The exact 6dd4527 candidate was under independent ownership, precedence, effect, cleanup, counter, and mutation-oracle review.

limitations: The third restart time and Fugu hedge stop time are operator-observed to minute precision; commit, session-file, and Claude event timestamps are exact to their recorded precision.
Active event logs may grow after capture; evidence hashes bind only the declared immutable byte prefixes.
The container cannot observe current Windows C-drive free space or prove VHDX compaction.
The Codex token value is a cumulative coordinator-thread sample and is not a billed-cost or per-package value.
Claude duration and cost values come from provider result events; Fugu review cost is unavailable, so cross-provider totals remain incomplete.
No five-packet comparable cohort or trusted current-wave integration existed at capture, so throughput, flow efficiency, useful parallelism, and the 20 percent KGI target remain unscored.
